name: Topics
overview: Scripture encourages believers to live courageously and with confidence, trusting that God is always present to strengthen and protect them, as seen in Joshua 1:9 and Psalms 91:1. It also emphasizes the importance of guiding and disciplining children in the ways of the Lord, assuring that proper training and correction will lead them to remain faithful, as taught in Proverbs 22:6 and 23:13. Additionally, the teachings of Jesus in Matthew highlight the value of humility and the seriousness of protecting the faith of the vulnerable, warning against causing harm to those who believe.
